name: superborrow
description: Hybrid local and IDE code completion with FIM context and reviewed next edits.

commands.title: Antigravity Tab: Use Superborrow for Tab

superborrow.enabled.description: Enable inline suggestions and in-memory document context.

superborrow.mode.description: Local uses only the loopback model. IDE uses the selected model. Hybrid routes by context and can fall back between available providers.

superborrow.ideModel.description: auto discovers a fast model from the signed-in Antigravity host. A pinned selection is antigravity:<slug> or vscode:<model-id>; use Select IDE Model to choose. Restored on startup.

superborrow.manageNativeTab.description: Use Superborrow as the Tab provider and turn off the competing native Tab provider. Use the Use Superborrow for Tab / Restore Antigravity Tab commands to switch and preserve the original preference. Only the native tabEnabled preference is changed.

superborrow.hybridPreference.description: Hybrid primary provider: auto uses context complexity; local prefers local inference; ide prefers the selected IDE model for every language. Failures may fall back to the other available provider.

superborrow.localApi.description: Local server wire protocol. Set endpoint and model to match.

superborrow.endpoint.description: Full HTTP loopback endpoint: llama.cpp /infill, Ollama /api/generate, or OpenAI-compatible /v1/completions. Redirects and proxies are disabled.

superborrow.model.description: Required model name for Ollama / OpenAI-compatible local servers.

superborrow.fimFormat.description: Raw FIM token layout for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible completions. llama.cpp /infill applies its own tokenizer.

superborrow.debounceMs.description: Wait after automatic requests before starting inference. Explicit requests skip this wait.

superborrow.requestTimeoutMs.description: End-to-end core timeout including debounce and fallback.

superborrow.maxTokens.description: Local output token budget and IDE input reservation. The portable IDE API does not expose an output-token limit.

superborrow.maxContextBytes.description: Bounded UTF-8 prompt context budget, including prefix, suffix, signatures and recent edits.

superborrow.projectContext.description: Optional stable project notes prepended to prompts. No project files are read automatically.

superborrow.exclude.description: Excluded file/path fragments with * and ? wildcards. Matching is case-insensitive. Excluded documents are removed from context.

superborrow.ideAdapterExtension.description: Optional installed extension ID exporting superborrowCompletionProvider v1. Activated only by Select IDE Model.

superborrow.corePath.description: Absolute core binary path. Empty uses the bundled binary, or the development checkout's debug binary.
